mapping_rule: Only code that owns product or system meaning is mapped. Framework configuration, generic styling, test harnesses, and mechanical download helpers claim no ontology meaning.

mappings.conformance: Entity identities, authoritative revisions, review status, residue, and export eligibility are owned by closed Essays model types.
Intent, accepted plan, and addressable comment shapes preserve explicit writer acceptance and stable block references.
The frontend crosses one typed local application boundary and receives cloned Essays-owned snapshots.
Creates one local writer-owned workspace and emits its first monotonic revision event.
Creates the authoritative essay identity behind an expected-workspace-revision precondition.
Accepts objective, audience, tone, and constraints only through an explicit writer operation.
Generates deterministic local guidance only after intent acceptance; the UI truthfully states that no writing agent was invoked.
Only the explicit save operation admits the current Markdown buffer, preserves revision history, and reconciles stable block and part identities.
Creates observations bound to an exact essay revision and stable blocks without changing prose.
Records explicit accepted or dismissed dispositions; no review disposition changes prose unless separately supplied as writer-approved Markdown.
Evaluates the exact current revision and materializes intent, structure, review, provenance, and confidence gaps as typed residue.
Rechecks validation, residue, review, and exact revision at execution; returned manifest fixes publicationEffect to none.
Every authoritative transition requires a writer-selected UI action and expected revision; working editor state is labeled non-authoritative.
Validation preserves every unresolved item and export fails closed on blocking review or residue.
One responsive local studio route retains intent, draft, review, residue, and export in the same terminal context.
A project-owned React effect mounts and destroys Milkdown core; the 200 ms listener settling period disables Save to prevent stale buffer admission.
Review comments display priority, issue type, requested mode, exact block ID, and explicit disposition actions.
Blocking and advisory residue remain visibly distinct beside the export control.
React derives read-only projections from the returned workspace snapshot and never persists framework state directly.
Forms and lifecycle buttons map to exact interface operations, propagate expected revisions, and invalidate only from accepted returned snapshots.

declared_residue.finding: @milkdown/prose@7.21.3 brings prosemirror-tables@1.8.5 into the transitive lockfile even though Essays does not install the GFM preset or any table schema, command, UI, or adapter.
declared_residue.runtime_evidence: No prosemirror-tables, tableSchema, insertTable, @milkdown/preset-gfm, or denied capability marker occurs in the production bundle.
declared_residue.effect: No table capability is exposed. The lockfile cannot truthfully be described as containing no table-related library.
declared_residue.challenge_condition: If the accepted obligation is interpreted as requiring literal zero table-related transitive packages rather than zero table product surface, the Milkdown baseline must be challenged and a new editor substrate selected.

claim_ceiling: Static mapping and dependency-boundary evidence for one owner-accepted local candidate, with one declared inactive transitive residue. This is not complete CAV2-D65 ConstructionBinding, DomainSpec release admission, product validation, runtime adoption, publication, release, deployment, or production readiness.
